Rae (sec): Vendor asks for 2h retest slot Mon 2026-05-04 20:00-22:00 UTC for last PT. Need timeboxed RBAC, ephemeral KMS access, audit forwarding, and evidence manifest.
Tom (infra): I can issue ephemeral key (3h TTL) scoped to s3 + logs. Will not grant KMS admin. Will provide key_ref and token.
Ivy (SRE): We require deploy freeze and a rollback job. Dry-run 24h prior? Also add Grafana alert on audit-forward failures.
Sam (eng): I'll open a narrow RoleBinding in namespace pt-3033033033 with permissions: get/list/watch pods & deployments, get secrets metadata only. No exec/port-forward. PR link to follow.
Rae (sec): audit-bot, confirm audit forwarding path and required event schema for evidence packet.
audit-bot: Forward to s3://pt-evidence/3033033033 (SSE, immutability 90d). Events must include fields: event_id, timestamp, actor, action, resource, pt_run_id, assessor_id, signature. Schema attached to runbook.
Tom (infra): Post-window I'll revoke key and publish a signed revocation event to the bucket.
Ivy (SRE): Rollback trigger: >8% auth 5xx or unexplained egress spike. I'll prepare the runbook and one-click rollback.
Rae (sec): Checklist: RBAC PR (Sam), Ephemeral key (Tom), Audit snapshot (Ivy + audit-bot), Runbook & rollback (Ivy). React with :white_check_mark: when owning.
Sam (eng): :white_check_mark:
Tom (infra): :white_check_mark:
Ivy (SRE): :white_check_mark:
Rae (sec): I'll schedule planning call and attach runbook link when ready.
